column.name: StatewideElevationFile
column.displayName: Elevation: LANDFIRE 30 m DEM (CONUS) or a 150 m grid (sets the model lattice)

column.name: FireZoneGridFile
column.displayName: Fire Zone Grid, 150 m (optional: blank = rasterized from the boundaries)

column.name: FireZoneBoundaryFile
column.displayName: Fire Zone Boundaries (pyrome shapefile, field PYROME; or a GeoPackage with field ID)

column.name: WeatherZoneGridFile
column.displayName: Weather Zone Grid, 150 m (optional: blank = rasterized from the NWS fire weather zones)

column.name: FireAgeFile
column.displayName: Fire-Age Classes, 150 m (optional: blank = built from the MTBS mosaics and interagency perimeters)

column.name: ZoneDailyWeatherFile
column.displayName: Zone-Daily Weather Table, CSV (optional: blank = built from gridMET)

column.name: IgnitionCovariateFolder
column.displayName: Ignition Covariate Folder, 30 m (optional: blank = built per zone from the rows below)

column.name: NlcdLandCoverFile
column.displayName: Annual NLCD Land Cover 2010, 30 m (ignition covariates)

column.name: HousingDensityFile
column.displayName: SILVIS Housing Density blocks, field HUDEN2010 (ignition covariates)

column.name: RawsHourlyFolder
column.displayName: RAWS Hourly Records Folder (FEMS station-year CSVs; P5 downloads missing ones here)

column.name: RawsCatalogueFile
column.displayName: RAWS Station Catalogue, FEMS JSON (optional: blank = fetched from FEMS)

column.name: InteragencyPerimeterFile
column.displayName: Interagency Fire Perimeters (NIFC history; fires under 405 ha in the fire-age map)

column.name: WeatherZoneBoundaryFile
column.displayName: NWS Fire Weather Zones shapefile (weather zones and station time zones)

column.name: GridMetFolder
column.displayName: gridMET Folder (var/var_year.nc: tmmx, rmin, vs, th, pr)

column.name: WrcBurnProbabilityFile
column.displayName: WRC Burn Probability (benchmark; 270 m or 30 m)

column.name: BpsFile
column.displayName: LANDFIRE Biophysical Settings (BpS) GeoTIFF, for vegetation strata
